title: Ned Tries a New Seed
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes eigh, ei, ey.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes eigh, ei, ey.

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling landing on top of a wooden bird table scattered with seeds.

pages.text: Ned spots a seed he has not had.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling noticing an unfamiliar dark seed among the usual bird seed on the table.
Ned the duckling pecking curiously at the new dark seed.

pages.text: The seed is hard. Ned gets a fright.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling jerking back slightly, beak snapping shut on the unexpectedly hard seed.

pages.text: Ned taps the hard seed on the perch.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling tapping the hard seed firmly on the wooden surface of the table.

pages.text: The hard shell cracks bit by bit.
pages.illustration: A small crack appearing in the hard shell of the seed.

pages.text: Inside the seed sits a soft bit.
pages.illustration: The cracked seed revealing a soft, pale centre inside.

pages.text: Ned taps the soft bit. It is good!
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling happily pecking at the soft inside of the seed.

pages.text: Ned grins and taps the next hard seed too.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling moving on to crack open a second hard seed, smiling.

pages.text: It was new at first, but Ned likes it now.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling standing contentedly on the bird table, several cracked seed shells around him.
